{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of NEW customers in PAID_SEARCH
new_paid_search = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (sales['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check if any such rows exist
if len(new_paid_search) == 0:
    print("No NEW customers reached by PAID_SEARCH were found.")
else:
    print(f"Found {len(new_paid_search)} NEW customers reached by PAID_SEARCH.")
    
    # Check the converted column
    print("Converted values:", new_paid_search['converted'].value_counts(dropna=False))
    
    # Compute fraction converted
    fraction_converted = new_paid_search['converted'].mean()
    print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
